context: Friends watch the World Cup final
purpose: Watch a final; teach ワールドカップ/前半/プレー/速度/抵抗/発揮/タイム/レース

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ついにワールドカップの決勝だ！
lines.en: At last, the World Cup final!
lines.style: hyped fan barely containing excitement, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 前半から動きが激しいね。
lines.en: The action’s intense from the first half.
lines.style: engaged fan reading the pace, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今のプレー、すごかった！
lines.en: That play just now was amazing!
lines.style: thrilled newcomer reacting on impulse, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 選手の走る速度が尋常じゃない。
lines.en: The players’ running speed is unreal.
lines.style: awed fan marveling at the athletes

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 相手の守備の抵抗も強いね。
lines.en: The opponent’s defensive resistance is strong too.
lines.style: analytical fan noting the matchup, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: エースが実力を発揮してるね。
lines.en: The ace is showing his full ability.
lines.style: admiring newcomer praising the star, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: スプリントのタイム、世界記録級だよ。
lines.en: His sprint time is world-record level.
lines.style: data-savvy fan citing numbers, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: これはまるで陸上のレースみたいだ。
lines.en: This is like a track race.
lines.style: fan drawing a vivid comparison, tone holding steady through the whole line
